customValues._note: GHL does NOT render {{ custom_values.* }} inside Custom Code elements (tested 24 Oct 2026), so the build bakes 'value' into the blocks. 'ghl' records which sub-account custom value each one mirrors: when you change a custom value in GHL, change it here too and rebuild. 'preview' overrides the value for the local preview only.

offer.contract: No lock-in contract. Cancel any time.
offer.trialTitle: Try review automation free for 30 days
offer.trialBody: Start with a 30-day free trial of review automation. We set everything up with you and launch your first review campaign, and you're only billed on day 30 if you decide to stay. No contract, cancel any time.

reviews.plansNote: Every plan includes one past-customer reactivation campaign, even if it goes over your monthly limit. Follow-ups never count towards your limit.
